Patmos Chapter Dashboard v1.3

2,545 reviews of the Cave of the Apocalypse and the Monastery of Saint John the Theologian. Merged v1.1 + v1.3 supplementary codes. Hover any code name for its codebook definition. Generated May 20, 2026.
Default view. Excludes gibberish, single-word, and off-topic reviews. Uncheck to use the full 2,545-review denominator.

Custom query — combine filters

Build a cross-tab. Click + Add filter for a simple filter, or + Add group to build (...)-grouped queries. Inside a group: AND or OR; between groups: AND or OR; NOT on any filter or group to negate. Example: (motivation_religious=1 AND religious_self_id=orthodox) OR (mediation=endorses AND devotional_participation=1).
Add a filter to begin.

Single-code prevalences

Corpus-level fire rates and cave-vs-monastery splits. Hover any code name for its full codebook definition. Each code carries a Cohen-κ badge showing how reliably the LLM and the author agreed on that code in the 100-review reliability sample.
κ ≥ .75 · strong reportable as-is κ .60-.75 · ok reportable with caveat κ < .60 · weak interpret with care circular new v1.3 code where hand-codes copied from LLM no signal neither fired in sample metadata not coded, sourced from platform

Engagement cohorts — sentiment & focus

Sentiment proxied by star rating (positive 4–5★, neutral 3★, negative 1–2★). Full corpus (n=2,545); does not follow the “useful only” toggle. Mirrors §2A of the markdown Chapter Dashboard.
